thread:
maria_support: Customer Harry reported: our WebSocket streaming in structured/json mode returns a truncated JSON object mid-stream. app parses and throws SyntaxError. Happened on iOS app behind corporate mobile proxy.

harry_customer: repro steps: open ws -> send {\"mode\":\"structured_json\", \"prompt\":\"summarize...\"} -> receive several delta frames then connection closes, last message is '...\"summary\": \"Great start' (no closing quotes/braces). Throws JSON.parse error. Happened 6x today.

maria_support: Attached customer logs: they used our JS client v0.12.1 -> websockets. Also included a hex dump of last frames.

maria_support: Quick reproduction attempt from my laptop using websocat:
```
websocat ws://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/stream
{"mode":"structured_json","model":"rw-open-7b","input":"x"}
```
I saw the same pattern when I forced a mid-stream abort with CTRL-C: last frame ended with truncated object.

dan_engineer: Can you paste the exact bytes for the final packets? Need to know if it's a server-side splice or client-side FIN.

maria_support: Hex snippet from customer capture (snipped):
```
0000: 7b 22 73 75 6d 6d 61 72 79 22 3a 20 22 47 72 65 61 74 20 73 74 61 72 74 69 6e 67 22 2c 20 22 63 6f 6e 63 6c 75 73 69 6f 6e 22 3a 20 22 73 6f 6d 65 20 6e 6f 74 65 ...
000f: 22 0a  (ends here)  -- note: missing ending \"}\n```

lee_infra: I pulled edge logs for that customer's IP. No 5xx from our fleet. Edge shows a TCP FIN from the proxy side ~200ms after last chunk; our backend signaled stream keepalive but then socket closed at edge.

lee_infra: Proxy (corp GW) sent RST/FIN mid-stream per pcap. Looks like an intermediate gateway aborted long-lived WS frames when it saw >30s idle between frames.

maria_support: Customer says frames were frequent, not idle. Could be a content length or frame size limit at proxy. They also said mobile went to background and then resumed.

dan_engineer: Two potential causes: 1) client dropped socket while we were streaming and partial JSON arrived at the app without final close frame, or 2) proxy reassembled frames incorrectly and dropped trailing bytes. Edge logs show we delivered final frame and then continued keepalives — need wire capture of server->edge.

cicd_bot: Deploy log: no recent runtime changes to ws framing code in last 2 weeks (deploy 1767730000 -> runtime/ws-streaming v1.4.3).

dan_engineer: For repro let's try to simulate abrupt midstream close without sending final terminating event. I can run a small script to send delta frames and then SO_LINGER close before the last frame is flushed.

dan_engineer: repro script (local test):
```
# python pseudo
send(ws, '{"delta":"part1"}\n')
sleep(0.2)
send(ws, '{"delta":"part2","summary":"start')
# close socket abruptly
s.close()  # simulate client crash/OS suspend
```
This produces identical truncated bytes at consumer side.

maria_support: Customer on iOS reported that when phone locks, app suspends sockets aggressively. That matches abrupt close scenario.

lee_infra: Mitigation options
- server: send smaller atomic JSON chunks (emit complete JSON objects per event) so partial object is less likely
- client: buffer until stream close or a final sentinel event (we should publish an "event: done" in the stream)
- SDK: add reassembly + tolerant parser that can accept multiple JSON objects instead of relying on a single top-level payload

dan_engineer: Long term we should: 1) change structured_json streaming contract to emit newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) frames where each event is a self-contained JSON object. 2) Add final 'done' event and sequence numbers.

maria_support: Short-term to help customer: ask them to switch client to our non-streaming call (stream=false) or upgrade to our latest SDK patch that buffers until event:done. For mobile specifically, suggest adding background task to flush and close gracefully or request short-completion responses.

harry_customer: can you advise exact SDK version that has the buffering fix? I'm on 0.12.1.

maria_support: Recommend 0.12.4 (hotfix) — contains stream reassembly + 'done' sentinel handling. If they can't upgrade, use REST non-streaming endpoints as workaround.

dan_engineer: I'll open an RFC to switch the stream contract to NDJSON and add a compatibility flag so we don't break older clients.

lee_infra: I'll also add a diagnostic header we can ask customers to enable: X-Debug-WS-Trace=1 that logs packet boundaries on edge for 7 days for the session id. That should help triage proxy vs client.

maria_support: Filed ticket SUP-7892, escalated to infra with pcap request. Sending recommended workarounds + 0.12.4 link to Harry. :white_check_mark:
